environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the Flask app on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application uses SQLite with the database file at /var/data/inventory.db. Python 3.11 runtime with Flask 2.3.x.

config.alb_config: default listener rules, no WAF attached
